# Gilbert Blythe & Phil Gordon

- [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) — Rival of — [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) — competitors for top honor in Freshman classes · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Again P0](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0000)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) settle into college life at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), aided by Philippa Gordon's social popularity, while [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) gains status after leading the Freshmen to victory in the Arts Rush. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives her first batch of letters from home, including updates from [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), as well as a note from [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md) revealing that [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) has been writing to her.
>
> — v3 · Chapter V Letters from Home

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), Philippa, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and Charlie go for a walk together in the park, enjoying the autumn scenery and discussing life. Afterward, they walk along [Spofford Avenue](../codex/places.md#avenue) and admire a quaint little house called Patty's Place, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feels a strong connection to.
>
> — v3 · Chapter VI In the Park

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) completes her first term at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) and returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for the [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holidays. She is warmly welcomed by [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), and [Dora](../character/dora.md), and she comforts [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) through a bedtime confession. Over the holidays, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives letters from friends, visits [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and enjoys reuniting with her loved ones.
>
> — v3 · Chapter VII Home Again

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends return to [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) for their Sophomore year and settle comfortably into [Patty’s Place](../codex/places.md#patty-s-place). After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is unexpectedly adopted by a stray cat named [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), the girls fail to humane-euthanize him, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to keep him. [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) arrives to chaperone the household, bringing along her own cats, [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) and the Sarah-cat.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVI Adjusted Relationships

> After chatting with [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) at Patty's Place, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes out to the orchard where [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) finds her and proposes. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) rejects his romantic suit, insisting she only sees him as a friend. Left heart-broken and awkward, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) leaves, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) retreats to her room to weep over the ruined friendship.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XX Gilbert Speaks

> During her pleasant visit to [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke) with [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits the small yellow house where she was born and learns more about her parents from the current resident. The woman hands [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a bundle of old love letters written by her parents, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reads reverently after visiting their grave. Reading the letters makes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feel truly connected to her parents for the first time in her life.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXI Roses of Yesterday

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to take a walk in the park on a windy autumn day, reflecting on her changing relationship with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). When her umbrella breaks in a sudden rainstorm, she is rescued by Royal Gardner, a handsome student who shares shelter and walks her back to Patty's Place. That evening, [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md) sends [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a dozen roses, sparking excitement and romantic speculation among her friends.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXV Enter Prince Charming

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) prepare at Patty's Place for a [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) reception. [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) mentions that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is frequently seen with [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md), which secretly disquiets [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). After leaving the house with [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) arrives at the reception and spots [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) across the room with Christine.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXVI Enter Christine

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives good news when her short story is accepted for publication, which raises her literary spirits. Later, while out on a walk with [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md), she learns his family plans to visit. However, Roy's mother and sisters arrive a day early on Friday, surprising the household and causing a flustered, humorous interaction before Roy's friendly sister [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md) connects warmly with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXVI The Gardners’Call

> As their final examinations come to an end, the girls and [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) reflect on what their four years at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) have taught them. For [Convocation](../codex/places.md#convocation) and the graduation dance, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) chooses to wear Gilbert's gifted lilies-of-the-valley and pink enamel heart pendant instead of Roy's violets. However, after [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) mentions a rumor about Gilbert's engagement to [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md), a hurt [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) snaps the necklace, turns [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) down for a dance, and masks her heartbreak during the night's festivities.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXVII Full-fledged B.A.’s

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) feeling disappointed and lonely after breaking off her relationship with [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md). She catches up on local news with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), learns about Jane's upcoming marriage to a rich man, attends Phil's wedding in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), and visits [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) after the birth of her baby boy.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXIX Deals with Weddings

> [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) asks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to walk with him to Hester Gray's garden, but she has to decline to prepare for Alice Penhallow's wedding. The next day, they go on their walk together to the old garden, where [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) proposes to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) again. She accepts him, and they clarify past misunderstandings about [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md) and [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md) before walking home together engaged.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XLI Love Takes Up the Glass of Time
